title: Mounts registry
description: Shared knowledge repositories this instance reads from a local checkout, each with its charter, plus this instance's own charter. Lives at the repo root. A mount is a content-only repository (knowledge domains, workspaces, a README — never specs, scripts, skills, tools, or scopes). Each machine enables a mount, and may point it at an existing checkout, in its gitignored .exobrain.json under mounts.<name> ({enabled, path}); by default the checkout is src/<name>/ in the main checkout. Only the domains a charter holds are indexed, each with the description the charter gives it. See knowledge/exobrain/mounts.md.

ids.description: Person ids, as the people/ collection names them.

never.description: What does not belong in the repository. topics are judged by the authoring review; terms are matched literally and patterns as regular expressions by the isolation gate.

$schema.description: Path or URL to this schema, for editor autocomplete and validation.

instance.description: This instance's own charter, relative to its mounts: who reads this repository, and what of it never goes into a mount.

mounts.description: One entry per mounted repository, carrying its charter.

name.description: Unique kebab-case id. Names the default checkout (src/<name>/), prefixes each mounted domain in the knowledge index (<name>/<domain>), and is the citation prefix (<name>:<path>); must not equal a local domain's directory name.

repo.description: Clone URL of the repository. An existing checkout is accepted when its origin is the same repository in any URL spelling.

audience.description: Who can read that repository. Shown in the knowledge index; a fact is recorded there only when everyone named here may read it, and the isolation gate runs on a land whose target audience includes someone the source's does not.

purpose.description: One line: what the repository is for. Written here, shown as the mount's index heading.

holds.description: The knowledge domains the repository carries, by directory name, each with a one-line description written here. Only these are indexed, and the description is the index row's summary — no text the mount's audience writes reaches an auto-loaded surface. A domain in the checkout outside this list is reported as charter drift; a land touching one is refused.
